biography.value: The commander of a pirate vessel, mutinous crew, or coastal raiding band.

system.tactics: The captain stays near the center of the crew, opening with Rally Cry or Intimidating Presence before choosing a vulnerable target. Defensive Stance protects the captain while the crew closes. Power Attack is reserved for an enemy already isolated or cornered against the rail. A captain who loses half the crew may bargain, flee, or surrender rather than die for cargo.
system.attacksNotes:
Longsword [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 5 ft One-handed:

  • Margin 1:: 13 damage (8 + 5 Str)
  • Margin 2: 13 damage, DR halved (round up)

Two-handed (versatile):

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (9 + 5 Str)
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up)

Thrown Dagger [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 30/60 ft

  • Margin 1:: 8 damage (4 + 4 Dex)
  • Margin 2: 8 damage, DR halved (round up)
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Feats

Defensive Stance: Can enter a defensive stance as a toggle. While in defensive stance, opponents add 1 to both attack dice when attacking you. Can enter or leave this stance at the start of your turn. Power Attack: Declare before making a melee attack roll. Add 1 to both die results and deal +4 damage on hit Rally Cry: You give a rousing speech to inspire your companions. Choose up to 6 allies who can hear and understand you. Each gains Temp HP equal to your Tier + your Charisma score. These Temp HP last until their next long rest. Intimidating Presence: As 1 [Combat] action, choose one creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you. Target makes Will save opposed by your Charisma + Intimidation. If you win, target gains the Frightened condition until end of your next turn. Battle-Hardened: When a creature hits you with an attack, that creature adds 2 to all subsequent attack dice against you until the start of your next turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Command the Crew: Once per round when an ally within 30 feet fails an attack or save, the captain may use a [Reaction] to grant that ally +1 to both dice on a reroll of the same attempt. The reroll stands.
